inputs.label: Your Killzone 2 disc: the dump folder that holds PS3_GAME, or a decrypted .iso. The US disc (BCUS98116) is tested; the European, Asian and Japanese discs are accepted but untested.
The 1.29 update folder of your disc's region: the folder that holds PARAM.SFO and USRDIR (on a PS3 or in RPCS3, dev_hdd0/game/<the disc's title id>).
Your decrypted 1.29 EBOOT.elf, made from that update. Skip it when it is already in the update's USRDIR folder.

prepare.label: Checks your copy, then builds the game on this PC

settings.label: Display mode
settings.help: How the game window opens. Alt+Enter switches between borderless and a window while you play.

settings.label: Pad layout
settings.help: Original is the game's own buttons. Modern changes the pad buttons only.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: Which buttons the game shows. Auto follows the pad you use.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The game's logs, to attach to a bug report.

exit_codes.2: No Direct3D 12 graphics device was found. Install or update the graphics driver; the game's log is in the build\logs folder.
exit_codes.3: The game was closed, but it did not shut down in time and was ended. Its log is in the build\logs folder.
exit_codes.5: The game stopped on an internal error. Its log is in the build\logs folder; please attach it to a bug report.
